'''Vella Derwayne''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] Protocol Officer.

==Biography==
One of the first things Derwayne did when she entered a [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] Adolescent Training compound was to turn her parents in to the ISB for conspiracy against the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. She was awarded the [[Palpatine Cluster]]
for academic excellence and graduated the top of her class.

At age 19, her first assignment was as a [[Training officer/Legends|training officer]] in Motivation, handling juvenile delinquents from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. She had the best reforming rate of the sector, drawing accolades from the sector [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. Derwayne was later transferred to [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Surveillance]] to keep an eye on military activities. She was assigned to a group of Imperial special operatives
which operated for several years in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==Personality and traits==
Vella Derwayne was a 25 year old Human female. She had dark skin and piercing [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She spoke with a coolly modulated voice and had a dark sense of humor. In any conversation, she immediately asserted her position of power by controlling what was talked about, and what wasn't.
